RagShortTexts: Niall joins kin and local chiefs.
Marriage, fosterage and gifts do not transfer every feud to all partners.

Variants.Content: Niall’s following joins kin and local chiefs. Marriage, fosterage and gifts form connections without making every district inherit another leader’s feud.

Niall joins kin and local chiefs. Followers retain family ties; decisions about guards and distant service affect common participation. Marriage, fosterage and gifts do not transfer every feud to all partners.
Marriage, fosterage and gifts do not transfer every feud to all partners. Coordination allocates actual supply and protection duties, not merely titles. Niall joins kin and local chiefs.

Marriage, fosterage and gifts do not transfer every feud to all partners. One promise may not bind every receiver, guard and supplier; negotiation needs actual responsibility. Niall joins kin and local chiefs.
